scope.month_attribution: ENTRY_MONTH; explicit +3/+5 exits may be in September

measurement_rules.family_checkpoint_metrics: All metrics on a family/month row apply separately to each listed checkpoint and remain unknown.
measurement_rules.frozen_denominator: Only a frozen INITIAL exact-family leg and event inventory can define six-month denominators; discoveries and returned symbol counts cannot.
measurement_rules.summary_counts: Source-reported aggregate counts stay in separate cohorts; they are not pooled with symbol rows.
measurement_rules.source_time: Unknown native event time remains null; candle bar_start/bar_end/available_at are distinct.
measurement_rules.delta: Reported historical_delta origin is unverified, not promoted to provider-native quote Greeks.
measurement_rules.quote_rule: Require native bid/ask/size, event time, availability, freshness, uncrossed markets and synchronized exact active legs at every checkpoint; midpoint is not execution.
measurement_rules.synchronization: No family assembled from discovery symbols. Front/back DTE require frozen leg roles; calendar_dte alone is not a family assignment.
measurement_rules.cache: Manifest/content IDs are references only; no cache lookup, provider query, or recovery from other worktrees.

enumerated_artifact_rows_only.disclaimer: Inventory of checked-in rows, not measured six-month market coverage or verified cache contents.

separate_prior_art.scope: Seven sampled checkpoints; 102 each; eligible five only August 25
